phases.name: Architecture: Trace Initialization Sequence with URL Parameters
phases.description:
Analyzed the page initialization flow to understand why the Uploads group wasn't visible when URL parameters were present. Root cause identified: The `loadComboOptionsFromYaml()` function is only called inside a DOMContentLoaded event listener in `initPage()`. However, when the scripts in index.html execute (at the end of the HTML body), the DOMContentLoaded event has already fired, so the listener never triggers and `loadComboOptionsFromYaml()` is never called. This means `injectUploadsGroup()` is never reached, leaving the Uploads group invisible.

Call chain traced:
1. initPage() - Sets up DOMContentLoaded listener but never fires (event already passed)
2. handleInputQueryParam() - Processes URL params, sets window.queryOptions
3. loadYamlInput() - Fetches input YAML asynchronously
4. loadSVGFromWasm() - Loads WASM module

The gap: loadComboOptionsFromYaml() is supposed to be called by the DOMContentLoaded handler in step 1, but since DOM is already loaded, this never happens.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Complete call chain documented from handleInputQueryParam() through injectUploadsGroup()
Identified exact line numbers where dropdown UI is rendered vs where group injection occurs
Confirmed whether injectUploadsGroup() is called at all when URL parameters present
Verified if toolbarComboState.groups array is updated with Uploads group
Documented all URL parameter combinations that cause the issue
Created flow diagram or detailed comment block explaining the issue

phases.name: Logic: Fix Uploads Group Injection in Initialization Sequence
phases.description:
Implemented fix by adding an explicit call to `window.loadComboOptionsFromYaml()` in the index.html initialization script, immediately after `handleInputQueryParam()` completes. This ensures that:

1. Query parameters are first processed by handleInputQueryParam()
2. loadComboOptionsFromYaml() is then called via setTimeout(..., 0) to allow all initialization to complete
3. The function fetches the options YAML, parses it (both flat and grouped formats)
4. Sets up toolbarComboState.groups array
5. Calls injectUploadsGroup() to add the Uploads group to the dropdown
6. Refreshes the toolbar combo UI

The fix uses setTimeout(..., 0) to defer execution to the next event loop tick, ensuring all initialization is complete. This handles both scenarios:
- When URL parameters are present: loadComboOptionsFromYaml() now gets called explicitly
- When no URL parameters: DOMContentLoaded handler in initPage() still works as fallback

Implementation details:
- Modified ui/html/index.html: Added explicit call after handleInputQueryParam()
- Added defensive check: only calls if window.loadComboOptionsFromYaml is available
- Added comment explaining the fix for future maintainers
- No changes to core injection logic; works with existing buildUploadsGroup() and injectUploadsGroup() functions

phases.name: Logic: Add Quick-Action Upload Button to Selected Mixins Panel
phases.description:
Implemented a quick-action upload button in the Selected Mixins panel header to provide users with an always-visible, direct way to upload files without needing to interact with the dropdown.

HTML Changes (ui/html/index.html):
1. Wrapped the title in a new 'selected-collector-header' div with flex layout
2. Added upload button with:
   - id="btn-selected-collector-upload"
   - Font Awesome upload icon (fa-upload)
   - Title: "Upload New Mixin"
   - Consistent .tool-btn styling
   - Responsive layout using flex with gap and flex-shrink

JavaScript Changes (ui/html/js/main.js):
1. Located the button element by ID in the DOMContentLoaded handler
2. Attached click event listener that:
   - Calls existing triggerToolbarComboUpload() function
   - Calls refreshUploadsGroupAfterStorageChange() after successful upload
   - Includes error handling with console logging
3. Placed handler near other upload button handlers for code organization

Behavior:
- Button is always visible in the Selected Mixins panel header
- Clicking it opens the file dialog for selecting YAML files
- After upload completes, the Uploads group is refreshed immediately
- New uploaded files appear in the dropdown and panel without page reload
- Works independently of the dropdown state
- Complements the existing "Manage Uploaded Mixins" button for different workflows

phases.name: Tests: Manual UI Testing with URL Parameters
phases.description:
Manual UI testing phase to validate the fixes work correctly across different scenarios. This requires running the application in a browser and performing the following test cases:

Test 1: Original Problematic URL
- Load: http://localhost:8080/?input=ext_release.yaml&options=ext_options.yaml&combo=ext_digital_twin.yaml&expandedIds=id_3_2_1_1_4%2Cid_3_2_1_1_3%2Cid_3_4_2
- Verify: Uploads group appears in dropdown
- Verify: Existing uploads from localStorage are listed in Uploads group
- Verify: Expanded boxes are displayed correctly
- Verify: No console errors

Test 2: Individual URL Parameter Combinations
- ?input=ext_release.yaml alone
- ?options=ext_options.yaml alone
- ?combo=ext_digital_twin.yaml alone
- ?expandedIds=id_3_2_1_1_4 alone
- Verify: Uploads group visible in all cases

Test 3: Upload Button Functionality
- Click toolbar combo dropdown → verify Uploads group visible
- Click quick-action upload button in Selected Mixins panel
- Select a YAML file to upload
- Verify: New file appears in both Uploads group and Selected Mixins
- Verify: New file can be selected/deselected
- Verify: SVG diagram updates when selection changes

Test 4: State Persistence
- Reload page with same URL → verify Uploads group still visible
- Verify previously uploaded files still appear
- Verify expanded/collapsed state is preserved

Test 5: Group Interactions
- Collapse/expand Uploads group → verify no errors
- Search/filter Uploads group items → verify filter works
- Select all items in Uploads group → verify all are selected
- Clear selections → verify all are deselected

Test 6: Browser Console Check
- Open browser DevTools → Console tab
- Reload page with URL parameters
- Verify: No errors, warnings, or undefined references
- Verify: No 404s for missing resources

Note: No automated browser tests exist in the project, so this phase requires manual testing with the running application.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Original problematic URL loads without Uploads group visibility issue
Uploads group appears with all individual URL parameter combinations tested

Uploads group collapse/expand works without errors
Search/filter works on Uploads group items
No JavaScript errors in browser console for any test scenario
SVG diagram updates correctly when uploads are selected/deselected
Expanded box IDs from URL parameters are correctly displayed

knownLimitations: Phase 4 (Manual UI Testing) requires running the application in a browser - automated browser testing is not available in this project. Users should perform the manual tests with a running instance of the application.
The setTimeout(..., 0) deferral in Phase 2 fix adds a minimal delay (~1-4ms) to initialization, though this is imperceptible to users.
The quick-action upload button in Phase 3 relies on localStorage persistence of uploads, which could be limited by browser storage limits on some systems.
